title: QGrilled Quinoa Agave-Leaf Wrap
description: A savory, tender dish featuring flour, char-grill-yang, and agave leaves as a festive paleo-friendly vessel for this Portuguese-inspired meal.
instructions: Soak agave leaves in water for at least an hour.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Mix flour with vegetable oil until evenly blended. Season as desired.
Grease the insides of the agave leaves lightly with a little bit of the flour mixture.
Place a scoop of cooked quinoa and a spoonful of your preferred vegetable filling inside each leaf.
Roll the leaves tightly to enclose the ingredients, ensuring they are well-sealed.
Heat a pan over medium heat and gently place the rolls in it. Cover loosely with foil and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, allow to cool slightly before slicing open and serving warm.
